## Instrument role

PANAMAX 48 is an automated magnetic-bead nucleic-acid extraction platform. Lysis releases nucleic acids, they bind to magnetic particles under kit-specific conditions, programmed washes remove contaminants, and purified material is eluted.

| Input | Machine action | Physical output | Recorded data |
|---|---|---|---|
| plasma aliquot | bind–wash–elute magnetic-bead program | purified cfDNA eluate | run ID, kit/lot, positions, volume, flags |

The instrument does **not** produce sequence reads or methylation calls. Those appear only after library preparation, NovaSeq sequencing, alignment, and cytosine extraction.

::: {.callout-warning title="Kit identity must be locked before this becomes an SOP"}
PANAMAX 48 supports kit-specific programs. The exact plasma-cfDNA kit name, catalogue number, validated input volume, elution volume, software/program version, and intended sample type must be copied from the study laboratory record. A viral DNA/RNA protocol is not automatically a validated cfDNA protocol.
:::

## QC gate

Track extraction blanks, positive/process controls where appropriate, eluate volume, fluorometric yield, fragment profile, contamination/hemolysis context, freeze–thaw history, and replicate concordance. Avoid relying on absorbance ratios alone at cfDNA concentrations.

[PANAMAX example documentation](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK572322/bin/fdacovideuas_142800.pdf) confirms the platform’s automated kit/program model but does not substitute for this study’s cfDNA kit manual.
